selected: reuse cached canonical point names and share each order index conversion, with lookup through the current model names
method: Pinned JS release builds. Library deep samples time 16 full searches each, with four process pairs and nine samples per process. Library ordinary samples time 500 calls, with three process pairs and nine samples each. CLI results include startup, input, serialization and peak RSS, with nine retained paired samples and alternating process order. Reversing arguments switches the initial order. Same-binary controls call 0.2.26 twice.

probes.method: Both probes wrap generated JS. Counts include warmups and budget checks. Phase times are aggregate process totals with timer and counter overhead; the table of elapsed performance uses uninstrumented samples.
